programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: The Old Man and the Lisa: Mr Burns loses all his money and employs Lisa to help him earn back his fortune. But they don't see eye to eye over ethical issues.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer and Lisa Exchange Cross Words: Lisa discovers that she has a knack for crosswords and enters a tournament. But Homer thinks he can make money by betting on her to lose.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade: Bart is held back a year at school and Lisa is moved up into the same class as him.

programme.title: First Dates: Valentine's

programme.desc: (2021) Tom Hardy returns as Marvel's gnarly antihero, to face a symbiote spawned from Venom's own blood living inside a serial killer who looks just like Woody Harrelson. Yikes.

programme.title: Naked Attraction
programme.desc: Psychology student Alesia is tired of dating 'boys' and hopes to meet a real man in the buff. And after 200 dates all over the world, Louise is ready to meet her soulmate.

programme.title: Martin Clunes' Islands of the Atlantic
programme.desc: The actor embarks on an epic journey to explore the ocean's islands, beginning with tropical jungles and grassland savannah off the western coast of Africa. He encounters giant snails and helps rescue endangered sea turtles in equatorial Sao Tome and Principe, which is also known as the African Galapagos. He then treks through savannah on the remote Bijagos Islands off Guinea Bissau to meet ferocious predators and a tribe in which the women hold the power

programme.desc: Ben Shephard hosts the quiz in which contestants answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the greater the prize fund. The player who has won the least amount is then eliminated, and the last one standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot

programme.title: Long Lost Family: The Mother and Baby Home Scandal
programme.desc: Part one of two. Davina McCall and Nicky Campbell examine the scandal of mother and baby homes which dealt with the 'problem' of unmarried mothers in this country and blighted hundreds of thousands of lives. In this episode, Jean, who was sent to the Home of the Good Shepherd in Surrey aged 16, looks for her first-born daughter. Plus, Viv and Julie begin a search on behalf of their mother Margaret for their older sister

programme.title: Unbelievable Moments Caught on Camera
programme.desc: A Miami real-estate agent rescues a woman from alligators and a group of British tourists almost drown in Egypt when their luxury yacht capsizes. An influencer couple flees from a Texas tornado and three teenage brothers save buried skiers after filming an avalanche in Austria. Plus, a pilot blogs his own plane crash into the Pacific Ocean and a trip to the hair salon before Prom sees one girl's dream haircut turning into a nightmare when a car crashes through the window

programme.title: Martin Clunes' Islands of the Atlantic
programme.desc: Martin heads to Madeira, where he takes a lesson in rallying on steep mountain roads that are perfect for the sport, and hears about the fate of Prince Renato II on an old sea fort that was once a tiny island in the main port of Funchal. He then visits the archipelago of the Azores, tasting the unique local dish of cozido das furnas on Sao Miguel, and learning about the history of whaling on Faial before heading out with one of the island's best skippers in search of sperm whales

programme.desc: Tá neart mistéirí le réiteach ag Pip agus ag Streak i gClós na mBalún inniu. (Pip and Streak have a lot of mysteries to solve in Balloon Barnyard today.)

programme.title: Elmo Anseo
programme.desc: Foghlaimeoidh Elmo agus a chara nua Cliste níos mó faoin gcraiceann inniu. (Elmo explores and discovers more about skin with his new friend, Smartie.)

programme.title: Pip & Posy
programme.desc: Caithfidh tú lámh a chroitheadh ar bhealach áirithe má theastaíonn uait a bheith i gclub Frankie. (Pip can't get the special handshake right to join Frankie's club.)

programme.title: Olobob Top
programme.desc: Caithfidh na hOlobobanna áit bhog a shocrú don Duine Mór le titim ann. (The Olobobs have to create King Jelly to provide a soft landing for Grown Up.)

programme.title: PJ Masks
programme.desc: Déanann gaireas nua Romeo diabhailíní d'Owlette agus de Catboy. (Romeo's newest device turns Owlette and Catboy into villains.)

programme.title: Wussywat
programme.desc: Tá Wussywat ag iarraidh a bheith in ann feadaíl ar nós Nín. (Wussywat wants to know how to whistle so she can copy Ird's tweeting.)

programme.title: Clifford
programme.desc: Ní mó ná sásta atá Clifford nár tháinig an bheatha is ansa leis. (Clifford is far from excited when the boat docks with a NEW kind of dog food!)

programme.title: Woozle & Pip
programme.desc: Tá sé ag cur isteach ar Woozle go bhfuil Pip ag iarraidh a bheith ina cat. (Woozle is jealous when Pip decides that she would like to be a cat!)

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Tá Ginger ag iarraidh rás a bheith aici leis na Piseanna-Rex Óga. (Ginger challenges the baby Pea-Rexes to a race around Vegesaur Valley.)

programme.title: Dot
programme.desc: Tá Dot ag súil go mór lena col ceathrar Margot a fheiceáil. (Dot is super excited to reunite with her cousin Margot.)

programme.title: Momonsters
programme.desc: Tá scéal le hinsint ag na Momonsters. (The Momonsters tell a story.)

programme.title: Cúla4
programme.desc: Níl aon easpa cláracha do dhaoine óga ar Cúla4 - bí ag spraoi agus ag foghlaim in éineacht linn. (Younger audiences will be spoilt for choice with Cúla4 - watch, play and learn.)

programme.title: Charlie agus Lola
programme.desc: Tá Lola ag ceapadh nach bhfuil Charlie agus Marv mór le chéile níos mó. (Lola is convinced that Charlie and Marv are not friends anymore.)

programme.title: Petronix Defenders
programme.desc: Tá giuirléid ceaptha ag Mo agus ag Joe le breith ar racúin ach cailleann siad smacht uirthi. (Mo and Joe invent a gadget to catch raccoons.)

programme.title: Pat an Madra
programme.desc: Tá béile blasta geallta ag a máthair do Lola nuair a fhillfidh sí ón dochtúir. (Lola's mother promises her a delicious meal when she gets home from the doctor.)

programme.title: Angelo Rules
programme.desc: Féachann Angelo agus Sherwood leis an bhfaitíos atá ar Lola roimh cholúir a bhaint aisti. (Angelo and Sherwood help Lola conquer her fear of pigeons.)

programme.title: Dónall Dána
programme.desc: Is deacair a rá céard is fíor agus céard is bréagach ann. (There is make believe, and then there is what Dónall believes, but which is the truth?)

programme.title: Cúla4
programme.desc: Níl aon easpa cláracha do dhaoine óga ar Cúla4 - bí ag spraoi agus ag foghlaim in éineacht linn. (Younger audiences will be spoilt for choice with Cúla4 - watch, play and learn.)

programme.title: Super Simple Amhráin
programme.desc: Amhrán spraíúil faoi dhul ag siúl sa gcoill. (A fun song about walking in the forest.)

programme.title: Blocuimhreacha
programme.desc: Beidh an-spraoi ag na Blocuimhreacha ag dul i bhfolach inniu! (The number friends take turns hiding behind each other in a song and dance all about bigger and smaller.)

programme.title: Blocdhathanna
programme.desc: Eagraíonn Corcra comórtas pátrúin. (Purple Organises a Pattern Competition.)

programme.title: Pramsáil
programme.desc: Tá rún ag Roy agus Caitríona dul chuig an bpáirc inniu ach cén chaoi a dtiocfaidh siad ann? (Roy and Caitríona want to go to the park today, but how will they get there?)

programme.title: Lá Le Mamó nó Daideo
programme.desc: Tá Aoibhinn leis an lá a chaitheamh ag obair in éineacht lena Daideo Paddy. (Aoibhinn is going to spend the day with Daideo Paddy.)

programme.title: Ó a Sheáin
programme.desc: Sa gharraí a bheidh Seán inniu. Cuireann sé tiúilipí áille agus tá sé an-bhródúil as a chuid trátaí. (Seán is gardening today. He plants some lovely tulips.)

programme.title: Garáiste Gecko
programme.desc: Oíche Shamhna atá ann agus tá na Meicneoirí ag imirt bob nó bia. (The Mechanics go trick or treating on Halloween.)

programme.title: Béiríní is a Leabhair
programme.desc: Faigheann cairde Ghobnatan amach go gcaithfidh siad meas a bheith acu uirthi. (Gobnait's friends learn to respect her right to do things the way she wants.)

programme.title: Béiríní is a Leabhair
programme.desc: Caithfidh Gobnait aird a thabhairt ar a cara más mian léi cabhrú leis. (Gobnait learns that to help her friend she needs to pay attention to what he needs.)

programme.title: Pikwik Pack
programme.desc: Tá Paca Pikwik ag iarraidh Post Pikwik a mhaisiú. (The Pikwik Pack are rushing to spruce up the Pikwik Post.)

programme.title: Nuair a Bheidh Mé Mór
programme.desc: Samhlaíonn Isabelle a saol ina múinteoir damhsa nuair a bheidh sí mór. (Isabelle imagines her life as a dancing teacher when she grows up.)

programme.title: Zou
programme.desc: Rachaidh Zou agus a chairde ag iascaireacht inniu. Tá comórtas idir Uncail Zavier agus Zou. (Zou and his friends go fishing today.)

programme.title: Dee Dee
programme.desc: Tá glórtha Boris agus Sandy athraithe ag DeeDee lena cuid draíochta. (Boris and Sandy can now say the tongue-twister but DeeDee has switched their voices with her spell.)

programme.title: Is Mise
programme.desc: Déanfaidh Sibéal fear bréige as seanéadaí agus féar tirim lena cara nua Noelie. (Sibéal will be building a scarecrow out of old clothes and hay with her new friend Noelie.)

programme.title: Ainmhithe Craiceáilte
programme.desc: Ar chlár an lae inniu beidh madra ag ní éadaí, cat óg ag léim thar sconsa agus firéid spraíúla. (Today a dog does the laundry and a kitten jumps for the fences.)

programme.title: Comhrá
programme.desc: Is é Jim Boland a bheidh ag comhrá le Máirtín Tom Sheáinín ar an gclár. (Máirtín Tom Sheáinín will be chatting with Jim Boland on the show.)

programme.title: The Wonder Years
programme.desc: Fágann Kevin bráisléad Winnie i dteach cailín eile trí thimpiste. (Kevin accidentally leaves Winnie's bracelet at another girl's house.)

programme.title: Geantraí
programme.desc: Sraith eile den chlár ceoil traidisiúnta. (Another series of the popular traditional music series.)

programme.title: The Golden Girls
programme.desc: Féachann Dorothy le dalta dá cuid as Meiriceá Theas a choinneáil sa tír. (Dorothy feels a sense of responsibility when one of her pupils looks like he will be deported.)

programme.title: Murder, She Wrote
programme.desc: Cuireann bean breabaireacht agus fianaise bhréige i leith Jessica. (Jessica is accused of bribery and false testimony by the daughter of a convicted murderer.)

programme.title: Rúin ón Spéir
programme.desc: Fiosraítear stair cheilte dheisceart agus oirthear na hÉireann ón aer. (A two part aerial documentary series exploring the south and east of Ireland.)

programme.title: Taste of Australia with Hayden Quinn
programme.desc: Tugann Hayden aghaidh ar na Adelaide Hills agus castar cara air ag na margaí. (Hayden travels to the Adelaide Hills and meets a friend at the markets.)

programme.title: Viva Ceol Tíre
programme.desc: Clár ceoil tíre á chur i láthair ag Jo Ní Chéide. (Jo Ní Chéide showcases country music videos filmed on location here in Ireland.)

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: Tá coincheap d'eastát réadach cruthaithe ag grúpa cairde as Arizona. (Friends from Arizona introduce the Sharks to the future with their mobile real estate concept.)

programme.title: An Aimsir Láithreach

programme.title: Scéalta ár Stampaí
programme.desc: Rachaidh Roxanna Nic Liam ar thóir scéal na drámaíochta mar a léirítear é ar ár stampaí. (Roxanna Nic Liam explores how drama is depicted on our postage stamps.)

programme.title: Domhan an Dúlra
programme.desc: Tugtar léargas sa gclár ar na bealaí éagsúla atá aimsithe ag ainmhithe chun bogadh. (Evolution has created many ways for living beings to move from one place to another.)

programme.title: An Aimsir Láithreach
programme.desc: Aimsir réigiúnach agus náisiúnta. (National and regional weather.)

programme.title: Nuacht TG4
programme.desc: Mórimeachtaí an lae ó Aonad Nuachta TG4. (The day's main news stories from a regional, national and international perspective.)

programme.title: Naíonra
programme.desc: Is léir faoin tráth seo go bhfuil dul chun cinn déanta ag na páistí sa Naíonra. (The educators are noticing the children's development in their final term in the Naíonra.)

programme.title: Ar Scáth na Sléibhte
programme.desc: Leanfaidh Cormac Ó hÁdhmaill ar a thuras i ngleannta agus le cósta Chontae Aontroma. (Cormac Ó hÁdhmaill walks the coast and glens of County Antrim.)

programme.title: An Aimsir Láithreach
programme.desc: Aimsir réigiúnach agus náisiúnta. (National and regional weather.)

programme.desc: Ní mór don Lone Ranger stop a chur le rainseoir atá ag iarraidh talamh na ndúchasach a thógáil. (The Lone Ranger investigates a rancher's plan to grab silver-rich Indian land.)

programme.title: Hector Caribbean
programme.desc: Tugann Hector aghaidh ar an bPoblacht Dhoiminiceach agus faigheann sé blaiseadh de shaol ilchultúrtha na tíre sin. (Hector gets to grips with life in the Dominican Republic.)
